hints.title: Multi-Day Pass Choice Obstacle
hints.text: Travel days can be covered using a 1-day pass, a 7-day pass, or a 30-day pass. How can evaluating ticket options ending at each calendar day determine the cheapest overall travel plan?

hints.title: Lookback Day Pass Invariant
hints.text: On non-travel days, cost equals cost on day d - 1. On travel days, cost is min(d - 1 cost + costs[0], d - 7 cost + costs[1], d - 30 cost + costs[2]).

hints.title: 365-Day Calendar Array Progression Procedure
hints.text: Store travel days in a fast lookup set. Create an array of size last_day + 1 initialized to 0. For each day d from 1 to last_day: if d is not in travel days, set entry d to entry d - 1. Otherwise, compute the minimum of entry max(0, d - 1) + costs[0], entry max(0, d - 7) + costs[1], and entry max(0, d - 30) + costs[2]. Return entry last_day.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Iterates through each day up to the final travel day.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive branching without memoization evaluates 3^N pass choices.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Array of size 366 uses trivial constant memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Distinguishing travel days from non-travel days to propagate pass coverage accurately.
